name: Water-Energy-Food Nexus in Agricultural Systems
description: Introduction to water energy food (WEF) nexus concepts in water resources and agriculture systems, water use in agriculture, food and energy sector: linkages to global and Indian perspectives, indicators of sustainable water use, agricultural and climate risks and its challenges towards food system, agricultural water management, water scarcity and stress, sustainable and environment-friendly water management and energy, principles of integrated water resources management (IWRM), wetland conservation and ecosystem-based approaches, water adaptation strategies for climate-resilient agriculture, crop modelling, planning and water management, role of decision support tools in water resources management, case studies such as the Namami Gange programme, success stories and innovations in water management, future perspectives.
